t: You're at numbers 3 and 3A Dean's Yard in Westminster, a school building. Two architects are credited with designing it. One is Sir George Gilbert Scott, the prolific Gothic Revival architect, best known for churches and cathedrals, who designed or altered more than eight hundred buildings. The other is John Oldrid Scott, also a British architect. The material I have is thin beyond that, so rather than guess at the details, take a look at the stonework and windows and see how the building sits among its neighbours around the yard.
